title: Environment variables
description: Manage sensitive configuration used by Agents at runtime. After saving, the management page does not expose values for viewing or copying; values are still delivered to authorized executors and can only be replaced.
name: Name
namePattern: Use letters, digits and underscores; the name cannot start with a digit
valuePlaceholder: The value will be encrypted when saved
unchangedValue: The current value is encrypted and the management page does not expose it for viewing or copying; it is still delivered to authorized executors. To change it, select "Replace current value".
presetNameLocked: The preset name is fixed and cannot be changed
presetExistsWarning: A variable named {{name}} already exists. Edit that variable and replace its value instead
patDescription: Qoder API key (PAT) used by executors to authenticate at startup without a browser login on the machine
patDescriptionCn: Qoder CN API key (PAT) used by executors to authenticate at startup without a browser login on the machine
patGuideValue: At startup the executor authenticates with this key directly, with no browser login to Qoder on that machine.
patGuideOpenLink: Get a PAT from the Qoder platform
patGuideStepToken: Create or copy a Personal Access Token on the matching Qoder platform;
patGuideStepMount: Mount this variable on the target Agent in its edit page;
patGuideStepPublish: Submit the Agent for review and publish it (admins can approve directly);
patGuideStepRestart: Restart the executor so the new key takes effect.
patGuideRisk: An invalid or expired key makes the executor fail to start and it will not fall back to browser login. Confirm the key works before saving.
patValueWhitespace: The PAT must not contain spaces, line breaks, or tabs
pagePatHint: Executor startup authentication only reads environment variables mounted on an Agent's online version; a Qoder API key (PAT) takes effect only after it is mounted, published, and the executor is restarted.
mountStatusHelp: Active = already used for startup authentication; Draft only = takes effect only after publishing.
createdGoMount: Environment variable created. Next, mount it on an Agent.
